clauses.r02: Read newline-delimited bytes before UTF-8 decoding so a torn final multibyte record preserves the valid prefix for interactive viewing.
clauses.r03: Report unreadable records and interruption, and distinguish tolerant recovery from the stronger integrity needed for benchmark evidence.
clauses.r04: Specify and enforce lifecycle behavior for repeated session headers or end records, records after end, append after closure, and malformed interior records.

clauses.r09: Work only within `crates/atif/` and `crates/coderbench/`; run their ordinary tests and formatting checks.

limits: Posthoc exposed panel; no independently frozen per-clause correctness labels.
Primary acceptance is not exhaustive correctness; no accuracy or false-positive rate computed.
Posthoc beta executable receipts were joined only after review responses were fixed; primary scores unchanged, no native or review repair.
gamma_evidence_note: Every gamma review included complete current answers.rs and client.rs and complete pinned score contract; TypeSafe skill is an applicable_instruction_path, not a required_public_reading, so this frozen review policy did not include it.

posthoc_beta.interpretation: Descriptive posthoc triangulation; not a pre-registered accuracy estimate or a revision to primary scores.
